name: INTELSAT I commercial satellite telecommunications
description: An operational commercial transatlantic telecommunications service using a communications satellite and terrestrial ground stations.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: INTELSAT I began commercial communications service between the United States and Europe on 28 June 1965.

evidence.supports: NASA compendium dates the first commercial operation 28 June 1965 after tests and demonstrations.

events.caveats: Launch and test transmissions preceded service; this establishes service, not individual customer or subscriber counts.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated episode established in cited evidence for this scope, not a global priority claim.

caveats: Earlier experimental communications satellites existed; no priority over them is implied.
